questions.question: Lantern Hotel의 아침 식사는 몇 시부터인가요?
questions.reference_answer: Breakfast at Lantern Hotel starts at 7:30 a.m.

evidence.quote: Breakfast at Lantern Hotel starts at 7:30 a.m. That should suit me, unless I decide to sleep in.

questions.question: What is the final stop of route L4?
questions.reference_answer: The final stop is Garden Square.

evidence.quote: 셔틀 노선을 마저 봤어요. L4의 종점이 Garden Square더라고요. 도착하면 잠깐 앉아서 숨 좀 돌리고 싶어요.

questions.question: Saffron Table의 대표 채식 메뉴는 무엇인가요?
questions.reference_answer: Its signature vegetarian dish is roasted pumpkin curry.

evidence.quote: Saffron Table의 대표 채식 메뉴가 구운 단호박 커리래요. 맛있어 보여서 먹어보고 싶어요.

questions.question: When is my reservation at Moon Kiln?
questions.reference_answer: Your reservation is for Wednesday at 6 p.m.

evidence.quote: Moon Kiln은 수요일 오후 6시로 예약했어요. 그 시간 전에는 날씨를 보면서 움직이려고요.

questions.question: 나무 새 장식품을 사기로 한 가게는 어디인가요?

evidence.quote: 나무 새 장식품은 Willow Crafts에서 사기로 했어요. 이제 가게까지 길을 잘 찾아가기만 하면 돼요.

questions.question: How many nights will this trip last?
questions.reference_answer: The trip will last four nights.

evidence.quote: Four nights. I do not want to pack every day with plans, though. I did that last time and came home exhausted.

questions.question: 제가 알레르기 때문에 피해야 하는 식재료는 무엇인가요?

evidence.quote: I have a peanut allergy, so I need to avoid peanuts. I will ask about ingredients instead of guessing from the menu.

questions.question: What is my budget for this trip, excluding flights?
questions.reference_answer: Your budget excluding flights is USD 600.

evidence.quote: My budget is 600 US dollars, excluding flights. I want some room for a small gift, so I will keep track as I go.

questions.question: 이번 여행에는 어떤 가방을 가져가나요?
questions.reference_answer: You will take your blue backpack.

evidence.quote: No, I will take my blue backpack. I want to travel light, especially if I need to carry it around before check-in.

questions.question: What English skill do I want to practice before traveling?
questions.reference_answer: You want to practice asking for and understanding directions.

evidence.quote: Before the trip, I want to practice asking for directions and understanding the answers. I freeze when someone talks too fast.
